We need to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014). We have four vendors: Acme, Orbital, BrightPath, Nimbus. We need to compare total delivered price, lead time, warranty. Then find cheapest vendor. Then search web for recent reviews of that cheapest vendor and summarise them. End with line 'Best price: <vendor>'.

We have data for each vendor:

Acme: unit 742, quantity 50 => subtotal 37,100. Shipping 450. Total delivered 37,550. Lead time 14 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

Orbital: unit 760, quantity 50 => list total 38,000. Volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units. So discount 4% of 38,000 = 1,520. So total delivered 36,480. Shipping included. Lead time 10 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

BrightPath: unit 715, quantity 50 => line total 35,750. Shipping 0. Total delivered 35,750. Lead time 21 calendar days. Warranty 2 years on-site.

Nimbus: unit 728, quantity 50 => total 36,400. Express shipping 300. Total delivered 36,700. Lead time 7 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

So cheapest total delivered price is BrightPath at 35,750. Next Orbital 36,480. Nimbus 36,700. Acme 37,550.

Thus cheapest vendor BrightPath. Need to search web for recent reviews of BrightPath. We already did search: result 1 is BrightPath Systems - customer reviews URL: https://reviews.example/vendors/brightpath-systems. We need to summarise reviews. We need to retrieve that page content. Use read_file? But it's a URL. We can use search_web again with query "BrightPath Systems reviews" maybe get content. Let's search again.
